reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the lab-tested QR code, which is better than most brands do, but I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need a sachet to carry around. I travel twice a month, and I can put my regular capsules in a pill case for that.
objection: I already take magnesium at home. Paying $29.99 a month for single-serve foil packaging is paying for the format, not for anything the magnesium does better.
